fields.description: Follow-up to roll-lqjj.53.1: incremental projection catch-up (read_tails, appended) still read appended segment and attempt bytes into Value trees and re-serialized each to hash it through Journal::add; the history cache was JSON arrays of Values; FileKey's 56-byte encoding was written twice; read_json_keyed did not presize its buffer. Read catch-up batches straight into a journal (projection::Appended), keep the cache in projection::codec, one FileKey::bytes.
fields.title: Read projection catch-up from line bytes, keep <ws>/history in the projection codec

data.text: Committed on branch perf/catch-up-lines-history-codec (198a35d + docs fixup): catch-up reads tails into projection::Appended via add_segment/add_attempt; <ws>/history in projection codec (magic 'bead history 2'); FileKey::bytes shared; read_json_keyed presized. ./check.sh green (1522 tests, doctests, 30 infra), clippy/doc/fuzz clippy clean, xtask tests rerun on HEAD. Not yet timed; not pushed. Public API changes: HistoryEntry::cached/from_cached -> history::cached/from_cached over bytes; FileKey::parts removed (bytes/from_bytes); prepare_extension/extend_projection take impl Into<Appended>.
